entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I hope you can help. I need to return my new VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed. I've been a loyal customer for years and I saved up for this.
I'm very sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?

It's not broken, I don't think. It's just so... confusing. I've tried reading the user manual, but it's really hard to use the workout tracking. I guess I just expected more from the interface. It doesn't seem intuitive at all, and I really needed this money back if it wasn't perfect.

I understand completely. It's important that you're happy with your purchase. It sounds frustrating when a new device isn't working the way you anticipated. Let me pull up your account and check the policy for you. Can I get your order number?
Yes, it's VF-886-2150. I just feel bad about it. I was so excited.
Thank you. Let me see... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It looks like it was delivered to you on January 2nd.
Yes, that's right. Is it too late? I'm so worried.
Let me just check the knowledge base here... Okay, good news. Our return policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery.
Yes, that's what my system says right here. Since you're only on day 12, you are well within the window. I can go ahead and process that return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, wow. That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. That honestly makes my whole week. I was so stressed about this.

Of course. I'm glad I could help resolve this for you. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address we have on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you again, Isaac. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
